Part (c) 

• 
Most responses presented a correct value (exact or numerical) for the slope of the line tangent to the path of the 
particle. 

• 
Virtually all of the responses that attempted to find the requested slope knew to compute a derivative. Most often 

the setup shown was some form of

Part (d) 

• 
Responses indicated that a majority of students knew that finding the total distance required integrating an 
expression for the particle’s speed. 

• 
Nearly all responses successfully used a calculator to evaluate the presented integral expression. 

What common student misconceptions or gaps in knowledge were seen in the responses to this 
question?
